summary: Principal-level backend/data engineer with 14 years building Python REST platforms, PostgreSQL data infrastructure, Apache Airflow and Kafka pipelines, and Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform operations — well above the role's 5-year minimum.

bullets.text: Lead the Python REST API platform serving all core banking services at Summit Ledger Systems.
Directed PostgreSQL and Terraform-provisioned infrastructure strategy for the data platform at Summit Ledger Systems.
Owned Apache Airflow and Kafka streaming pipelines processing 500M+ events daily at Delta Harbor Technologies.
Containerized the entire data platform with Docker and Kubernetes at Delta Harbor Technologies.
